title: Climate Policies and Electricity Prices: Why Abate When You Can Generate?
title_zh: 气候政策与电价：为何不减排而选择发电？
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Economic Policy · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: Climate policies often increase electricity prices by more than they increase prices of fossil fuels. Using administrative data on German manufacturing plants from 2009 to 2017, we provide evidence that these price changes induce plants to generate electricity onsite using fossil fuels. Not all manufacturing plants are subject to emissions pricing under the EU’s Emissions Trading System, and we find evidence of emissions leakage: Electricity generation shifts from regulated power plants to unregulated manufacturing plants.
abstract_zh: 气候政策往往导致电价涨幅超过化石燃料价格涨幅。基于2009年至2017年德国制造业工厂的行政数据，我们证实此类价格变化会促使工厂利用化石燃料进行现场发电。并非所有制造业工厂都受欧盟排放交易体系的排放定价约束，我们发现了排放泄漏的证据：发电活动从受监管的发电厂转移至未受监管的制造业工厂。

title: Detection of Collusive Networks in Multistage Auctions
title_zh: 多阶段拍卖中共谋网络的检测
authors: Baránek, Bruno, Musolff, Leon, Titl, Vítězslav
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We develop a method for detecting cartels in multistage auctions. Our approach allows firms to act collusively against cartel members yet competitively otherwise. In these auctions, bidders submit initial bids and can later revise them downward. As initial bids are shaded, close initial bids indicate similar costs and thus create strong incentives to undercut rivals. We classify firm pairs as collusive if they ignore this incentive by failing to update bids against each other, relative to other pairs with similarly close initial bids. Our algorithm predicts Ukraine’s Antimonopoly Committee sanctions: classified pairs are nine times more likely to be sanctioned.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种在多阶段拍卖中检测卡特尔的方法。该方法允许企业在针对卡特尔成员时采取合谋行为，而在其他情况下则保持竞争。在这类拍卖中，竞标者提交初始报价，随后可向下调整报价。由于初始报价存在折价，相近的初始报价表明成本相似，从而产生强烈的降价竞争动机。我们将那些相对于其他初始报价相近的配对而言，未能针对彼此更新报价、从而忽视这一动机的企业配对判定为合谋。我们的算法预测了乌克兰反垄断委员会的制裁结果：被判定为合谋的配对受到制裁的可能性是其他配对的九倍。

title: Endogenous Tracking: Sorting and Peer Effects
title_zh: 内生追踪：分类与同伴效应
authors: Chernulich, Aleksei, Gauriot, Romain, Min, Daehong
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Can an educational system without ability tracking and signalling motive generate self-sorting of students by ability? We build a theoretical model to show that when seeking positive peer effects is combined with costly educational choices, even in the absence of exogenous requirements on achievements used in standard tracking systems, high-achieving students self-sort by choosing costly courses, which we refer to as endogenous tracking. We use data from French middle schools, where students were grouped together based on their choices between Spanish and effort-costly German language classes, to show that costly language class choices lead to sorting and to identify peer effects.
abstract_zh: 一个缺乏能力分层和信号动机的教育体系，能否促使学生按能力进行自我分类？我们构建了一个理论模型，表明当追求正向同伴效应与高成本教育选择相结合时，即使没有标准分层体系中对学业成绩的外生要求，高成就学生也会通过选择高成本课程实现自我分类——我们将此称为内生分层。我们利用法国初中数据（学生根据西班牙语与高努力成本的德语课程选择进行分组）证明，高成本语言课程选择会导致分层现象，并识别出同伴效应。

title: Labor Market Responses to Tariffs: Frictions, Dynamics, and Policy Responses
title_zh: 关税对劳动力市场的影响：摩擦、动态与政策应对
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This article introduces the evidence and associated modeling frameworks contemporary economists use to understand the effects of trade and trade policy on labor markets, with a particular emphasis on labor-market frictions and adjustment dynamics. The effects of trade shocks differ across industries, regions, and occupations, implying the presence of important adjustment frictions in labor markets, and these effects evolve slowly over time, implying the need for dynamic frameworks rationalizing slow transitions. After reviewing the key insights from this literature, we discuss policies aimed at mitigating costs to workers and ensuring that the gains from trade are shared more equitably.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了当代经济学家用于理解贸易及贸易政策对劳动力市场影响的实证证据及相关建模框架，特别关注劳动力市场摩擦与调整动态。贸易冲击的影响因行业、地区和职业而异，这表明劳动力市场中存在重要的调整摩擦，且这些影响随时间缓慢演变，意味着需要构建能够解释缓慢转型的动态框架。在梳理该领域关键见解后，本文探讨了旨在减轻工人成本、确保贸易收益更公平分配的政策措施。

title: Decentralization, Service Delivery, and Legitimacy: The Case of Mali
title_zh: 分权、服务提供与合法性：以马里为例
source: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
official: 官方在线 2026-06-18 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: In fragile, conflict-affected, and violent contexts, decentralization is widely promoted to improve service delivery and strengthen the social contract by shifting power closer to citizens. However, empirical evidence on whether these reforms deliver in environments marked by weak state capacity and low institutional trust remains limited. This paper evaluates Mali’s Project for the Deployment of State Resources for the Improvement of Services program, which implemented performance-based conditional grants across 102 communes between 2021 and 2024. Drawing on administrative budget data and georeferenced Afrobarometer survey data, the study assesses the impacts of performance-based conditional grants on local fiscal performance, service delivery, and institutional legitimacy. The results show that a 1 percent increase in performance-based conditional grant allocations is associated with a 1.2 percent increase in investment expenditures and measurable improvements in budget balances. Expenditures were reallocated toward social sectors (education, health, water, and agriculture), consistent with program objectives. A difference-in-differences analysis points to statistically significant increases in citizen satisfaction with public services, particularly health (+2.6 percentage points), water and sanitation (+1.4), and education (+1.0), as well as an 18.4-point rise in trust in municipal councils. Institutional “spillover” effects extended to the national level, with trust in the presidency and parliament increasing by 9.1 and 7.3 points, respectively. A scenario-based cost-effectiveness analysis points to potentially substantial returns under the stated assumptions. Illustrative estimates suggest that observed trust gains could be associated with USD 57 million to USD 141 million in additional annual tax revenues, equivalent to 1.1 to 2.8 times the program’s total cost, through enhanced voluntary compliance—assuming a transmission of trust into compliance broadly consistent with parameters in the literature. These findings are consistent with the view that well-designed performance-based transfers may improve service outcomes and contribute to rebuilding public trust in fragile, conflict-affected, and violent contexts, with effects that appear to extend beyond the local level. Policy implications include considering institutionalization of the performance-based conditional grants within Mali’s fiscal architecture and the design of a medium-term roadmap for sustainability and possible scale-up.
abstract_zh: 在脆弱、受冲突影响及暴力频发的环境中，分权改革被广泛推广，旨在通过将权力下放至公民层面来改善公共服务供给并强化社会契约。然而，关于此类改革在政府能力薄弱、制度信任度低的环境中能否取得成效，现有实证证据仍然有限。本文评估了马里2021至2024年间在102个市镇实施的"国家资源部署以改善服务项目"中的绩效挂钩有条件拨款计划。基于行政预算数据与地理参照的非洲晴雨表调查数据，本研究评估了绩效挂钩有条件拨款对地方财政绩效、公共服务供给及制度合法性的影响。结果显示：绩效挂钩有条件拨款每增加1%，投资支出相应增长1.2%，预算平衡状况出现可测度的改善。支出向教育、卫生、水利和农业等社会领域重新配置，这与项目目标一致。双重差分分析表明，公民对公共服务的满意度出现统计显著的提升——卫生服务满意度提高2.6个百分点，供水和卫生设施满意度提高1.4个百分点，教育满意度提高1.0个百分点；同时，对市镇议会的信任度上升18.4个百分点。制度"溢出效应"延伸至国家层面，对总统和议会的信任度分别提升9.1和7.3个百分点。基于情景的成本效益分析显示，在既定假设条件下可能产生可观回报。估算表明，通过增强自愿纳税遵从度，观察到的信任增益可能带来每年5700万至1.41亿美元的额外税收收入，相当于项目总成本的1.1至2.8倍——这一估算假设信任向遵从度的传导机制与文献参数基本一致。这些发现支持以下观点：设计良好的绩效挂钩转移支付能够改善服务成效，并有助于在脆弱、受冲突影响及暴力频发的环境中重建公众信任，其影响似乎超越地方层面。政策启示包括：考虑将绩效挂钩有条件拨款纳入马里财政架构的制度化设计，并制定中期路线图以保障可持续性及可能的推广。

title: Systemic Banking Crises Database: 1970-2025
title_zh: 系统性银行危机数据库：1970-2025
authors: Mr. Luc Laeven & Mr. Fabian Valencia
official: 官方在线 2026-05-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper presents an updated version of the Laeven and Valencia (2013, 2020) database on systemic banking crises, extending the coverage through 2025. The update incorporates new episodes, while maintaining the definition established in previous editions, which emphasizes both significant signs of financial distress and substantial policy interventions. The update integrates textual tools to screen potential candidates that are then further scrutinized to confirm if our definition is met. The database includes information on banking crises episodes during 1970-2025, including starting dates, policy responses, fiscal costs, and output losses. It offers a comprehensive tool for assessing cross-country vulnerabilities and policies to resolve banking crises.
abstract_zh: 本文呈现了Laeven与Valencia（2013, 2020）系统性银行危机数据库的更新版本，将覆盖范围扩展至2025年。此次更新纳入了新危机事件，同时沿用先前版本确立的定义标准，该定义强调显著的金融困境迹象与大规模政策干预。更新过程整合了文本分析工具以筛选潜在候选事件，随后对这些候选事件进行深入审查，以确认是否符合定义标准。该数据库涵盖1970-2025年间的银行危机事件信息，包括起始日期、政策应对措施、财政成本及产出损失。它为评估跨国脆弱性及化解银行危机的政策提供了综合性工具。

title: State Capacity as an Organizational Problem
title_zh: 组织能力作为一个组织问题
abstract: Abstract We investigate how technologies that reduce the costs of monitoring by central authorities have shaped the historical transition from small patrimonial states to large bureaucratic organizations. Our analysis is based on a novel dataset that traces changes in the organizational structure and geographic presence of the U.S. federal government over the nineteenth century. To identify causal effects, we develop a new identification strategy that exploits the expansion of the railroad network as a source of variation in the travel time–and thus monitoring costs–between Washington D.C. and other locations. We present three main findings. First, reductions in travel time to Washington D.C. significantly increased the likelihood of federal government presence in a location. Second, this effect is stronger for occupations and tasks characterized by more severe agency problems. Third, decreases in travel time to Washington D.C. are associated with a decline in patrimonial features of the federal government in the location, in line with enhanced monitoring capacity reducing dependence on personal trust and connections.

title_zh: 水之功效：美国安全饮用水的成因与影响
authors: Keiser, David A, Mazumder, Bhashkar, Molitor, David, Shapiro, Joseph S
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study the effect of pre-booked COVID-19 vaccination appointments using a nationwide campaign in Austria. Leveraging administrative microdata on more than 450000 initially unvaccinated adults, we exploit cross-state variation in program participation and staggered appointment timing in a difference-in-differences design. Pre-booked appointments increase vaccination on the appointment day by 0.8 percentage points (8 per 1000), with no evidence of intertemporal substitution. Effects are larger for socio-economically disadvantaged individuals and substantially weaker in areas with stronger vaccine skepticism. The findings suggest that behavioral interventions are effective when low uptake reflects frictions, but have limited impact when driven by entrenched skepticism.

title: Learning in the Limit: Income Inference from Credit Extensions
title_zh: 极限学习：从信贷扩展中推断收入
abstract: ABSTRACT Combining a randomized controlled trial with administrative and survey data, this paper shows that credit limit extensions significantly increase total spending and income expectations. By controlling for changes in personal income expectations, the spending response to credit limit extensions weakens by approximately 30%. For financially unconstrained consumers, expectation changes account for around two‐thirds of the spending responses to limit extensions. These findings are consistent with consumers inferring future income from credit supply.
